phrases.text: Treasure Hours are today, and Pirate Shop Access odds are boosted. Here's the schedule!
Round one: two to four PM Eastern. That's one to three Central.
Round two: nine to eleven PM Eastern. Eight to ten Central.
Both rounds: one point five times the normal odds for Pirate Shop Access.
Squad up and open every chest. Are you playing both rounds?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
